## Dates and itinerary

**12–20 February 2027 · 9 days / 8 nights.**

Rio de Janeiro, 3 nights → Foz do Iguaçu, 2 nights → Buenos Aires, 3 nights. The excursion to the Argentine side of Iguazu Falls is included in the main programme. A trip to Uruguay is offered separately on your free day in Buenos Aires.

## Price per person

All prices are in US dollars. SGL: single occupancy; DBL: double occupancy; TPL: triple occupancy.

| Hotel category | SGL | DBL | TPL |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 3★ | $5,619 | $4,306 | $4,300 |
| 4★ | $6,523 | $4,696 | $4,450 |
| 5★ | $7,955 | $5,585 | $5,205 |

Domestic flights **Rio – Iguazu – Buenos Aires are included** in these rates. The specific hotel names are confirmed at the time of booking. International flights are charged separately.

The first three days are devoted to Rio. After daytime excursions to Sugar Loaf and Corcovado, you will spend the night at the Parade of Champions. The itinerary then takes you to Iguazu Falls: the Brazilian panoramas and the walkways on the Argentine side offer different views of the cascades. In Buenos Aires, you have time to explore the city, enjoy the included tango show and spend a free day walking around or taking a separate excursion.
